title: Preserve pending edits when entering Inspect mode
steps: Select the Rectangle tool, draw a rectangle, and inspect the visible Saving state before autosave finishes.
Switch the sidebar to Inspect and inspect the View Only workspace after the autosave interval.
Return to Dashboard (Projects) and reopen Inspect Save Study.

video_guide.summary: The newly drawn rectangle remains available after entering Inspect, returning to Dashboard, and reopening the same file.

chapters.note: The new rectangle is selected on the canvas and listed in Layers.
Inspect shows the rectangle in view-only mode with its properties.
After returning to Dashboard and reopening the file, the rectangle remains visible on the canvas and in Layers.
